newsitem.title: HONG KONG: KEL Holdings debuts at HK$1.48 per share.
newsitem.headline: KEL Holdings debuts at HK$1.48 per share.

text.p: Shares of electrical and mechanical engineering services concern KEL Holdings Ltd debuted at HK$1.48 per share on Thursday, compared with the issue price of HK$1.00.

KEL, a spinoff of marine engineering group UDL Holdings Ltd, issued 100 million new shares at HK$1.00 each in its initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong. Its IPO was 173 times subscribed.
It said the HK$90 million in net proceeds would be used for business expansion and for working capital.
The company engages in the design, supply, installation and maintenance of electrical and mechanical engineering services in the building and construction industry in Hong Kong and China.
